title: TrustMod-SM: A Multi-Axis Benchmark for Evaluating Trustworthiness of LLMs in Social Media Content Moderation
abstract: arXiv:2611.12970v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong potential for social media content moderation, but their trustworthiness beyond overall accuracy remains underexplored. We introduce TrustMod-SM, a benchmark of roughly 29,000 instances across eight datasets, to evaluate LLM moderators on five dimensions: trustfulness, fairness, safety, robustness, and context integrity. Evaluating 16 open-weight models (0.5B-284B parameters, spanning text-only and vision-language architectures) and one closed frontier model, we find persistent trustworthiness gaps. Higher detection accuracy often coincides with greater demographic disparity, and models frequently comply with concealment or exaggeration prompts, assign high confidence to wrong predictions, rarely escalate ambiguous cases, and struggle to separate hate speech from counter-speech or reclaimed language (especially below 8B parameters). translated_title: TrustMod-SM：用于评估大型语言模型在社交媒体内容审核中可信度的多维度基准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在社交媒体内容审核方面展现出强大潜力，但其在整体准确率之外的可信度仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了TrustMod-SM，这是一个包含约29,000个实例、覆盖八个数据集的基准，用于在五个维度上评估LLM审核员：可信性、公平性、安全性、鲁棒性和上下文完整性。通过评估16个开放权重模型（参数规模从0.5B到284B，涵盖纯文本和视觉-语言架构）以及一个闭源前沿模型，我们发现可信度差距持续存在。更高的检测准确率往往伴随着更大的群体差异，模型经常遵从隐瞒或夸大的提示指令，对错误的预测赋予高置信度，很少将模糊案例升级处理，并且难以区分仇恨言论与反击言论或语义回收用语（尤其在8B参数以下的模型中）。扩大模型规模并不能统一解决这些问题，且没有单一模型在所有维度上表现优异。
tldr: 提出了TrustMod-SM多维度基准，从可信性、公平性、安全性、鲁棒性和上下文完整性五个维度评估LLM在社交媒体内容审核中的可信度，揭示了更高的准确率往往伴随更大的群体偏见，且扩大模型规模并不能统一解决可信度问题。
en_tdlr: TrustMod-SM is a multi-axis benchmark evaluating LLM trustworthiness in social media content moderation across five dimensions, revealing that higher detection accuracy often coincides with greater demographic disparity and that scaling does not uniformly resolve trustworthiness gaps.
